# ABCD Digital Hub

> Custom Full-Stack Web Application Development, Multi-Tenant SaaS Systems, and AI-Powered Automation Workflows.

ABCD Digital Hub (https://abcddigitalhub.com) is a high-performance software engineering studio and digital consulting agency. We engineer end-to-end web applications, scalable SaaS architectures, and autonomous business workflows for startups, scaleups, and forward-thinking enterprises.

- **Primary Specialization**: Custom Full-Stack Web Application Development
- **Engineering Stack**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, PostgreSQL (Neon Serverless), Prisma ORM, Tailwind CSS, Redis, Vercel Edge Infrastructure
- **AI Integrations**: Google Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash), Groq, Vercel AI SDK, autonomous agent workflows, automated grading, intelligent lead scoring
- **Leadership**: Founded & Architected by Suman Baidya
- **Headquarters & Reach**: Serving global clients across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific with high-availability cloud architecture

## Core Service Offerings

### 1. Full-Stack Web Application Development
- Bespoke web application design and engineering tailored to complex business logic
- Modern reactive frontend architecture using Server Components and optimistic UI
- Scalable backend APIs, serverless databases, real-time WebSockets/WebRTC, and third-party integrations
- Mobile-first responsiveness tested down to 375px viewports with zero horizontal overflow

### 2. Multi-Tenant SaaS Product Engineering
- Multi-tenant tenant schema isolation and dynamic routing
- Role-based access control (RBAC) with secure session handling (NextAuth / Auth.js with OAuth 2.0)
- Subscription monetization, automated milestone invoicing, and digital contract signing audit ledgers
- Production SLAs with 99.9% uptime benchmarks and edge load-balancing

### 3. Autonomous AI & Workflow Automation
- Integration of large language models for real-time natural language processing and structured data extraction
- Anti-cheat online proctoring, AI question generation, and automated assessment scoring
- Omnichannel marketing automation engines unifying email drips, WhatsApp APIs, and lead scoring

### 4. Technical Architecture Audits & Modernization
- Migration from legacy architectures to modern Next.js edge deployments
- Database query optimization, index tuning, and latency reduction
- Core Web Vitals optimization achieving near-perfect 95+ performance scores

## Proprietary Software Platforms (EcoSys)

ABCD Digital Hub engineers and licenses proprietary turnkey software platforms:

1. **ABCD Exam Hub** (https://abcddigitalhub.com/ecosystem#abcd-exam-hub)
   - *Category*: EdTech SaaS / Examination Platform
   - *Key Features*: AI Question Generator, Automated Evaluation Engine, Real-Time WebRTC Anti-Cheat Screen & Camera Proctoring, Multi-Tenant Portals for Schools, Teachers & Students, Granular Analytics
   - *Target Audience*: Schools, Universities, Coaching Centers, Online Academies
   - *Stack*: Next.js 15, PostgreSQL, WebRTC, Google Gemini AI, Tailwind CSS, Redis

2. **AutomateGrowth AI** (https://abcddigitalhub.com/ecosystem#automate-growth-ai)
   - *Category*: Autonomous Marketing & CRM Engine
   - *Key Features*: Omnichannel Lead Scoring, Multi-Step Email & WhatsApp Drips, AI Copywriting Personalization, Dynamic CRM Routing, Conversion Funnel Telemetry
   - *Target Audience*: Digital Agencies, E-Commerce Brands, B2B Sales Teams
   - *Stack*: Next.js 15, Node.js, Resend API, Meta Cloud API, PostgreSQL, Vercel AI SDK
